name: Database table quality check
summary: Once a month, or before a migration, a report or an automation is built on a table, its owner gets one numbered findings sheet: duplicate keys, blank required fields, values off the allowed list, bad dates and numbers, broken links, each with its rows. Nothing is changed.

sources.title: Checking one exported table against rules its owner writes once (required fields, the key, allowed values, date and number formats, links to other tables): every row counted against the tool's own count, duplicate keys and look-alike records under different keys, blanks, values off the list, malformed dates and numbers and links to missing records each reported with row references and a count, missing rules written as questions, a stop on any header that does not match, and the rule that no record is changed, merged or deleted, written for this template.
